title: Grateful Dead Live at Betty Nelson's Organic Raspberry Farm on 1968-09-02
lineage: SBD > Reel > DAT > ZA2 > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Rough‑sounding Volkerding soundboard with noticeable mix issues still captures a stellar ’68 performance highlighted by a blazing Dark Star, St. Stephen and an epic 69‑minute Eleven.
ai_review.review: The show is widely praised as a high‑energy continuation of the August ’68 runs, with fast tempos and standout moments on Dark Star, St. Stephen and a marathon The Eleven.  While the Volkerding soundboard source suffers from buzz, occasional clipping and a weak mix that buries Bob Weir’s vocals and Phil Lesh’s bass, most listeners feel the performance outweighs those flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is consistently rated very high (5‑star reviews) while recording quality receives mixed comments; weighted average yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is uneven – Weir’s vocals and Phil’s bass are often buried, buzz and occasional clipping noted. Overall acceptable for a 1968 soundboard capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Flows like the August shows with high energy and fast tempos; regarded as a solid, cohesive performance despite some recording rough spots.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Dark Star is praised as "great to hear" indicating strong Garcia guitar work.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is described as being low in the mix, making Phil hard to hear.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir's vocals and rhythm guitar are barely audible due to the poor mix.
